setup_difference: Original hourlyMySQLFixture provisions the same fresh schema/account and stays unchanged. A same-DSN GORM pool with copied GORM/MySQL configs and only custom DriverName is initialized outside timer; original fixture pool remains idle. Extra VERSION/ping outside timer are not counted. The benchmark later enforces the same one-connection policy on the wrapped pool.
metric_semantics: Driver call/consume/prepare blocking spans, not original Scan body or original source performance. Rows lifetime includes caller gaps and overlaps query/consume spans; never sum with them. ErrSkip attempts are separate, actual fallback statement execution counted once. All unknown SQL is other.
uncovered: Pool wait, argument conversion, GORM build/model parsing/logger work, driver Columns/ColumnTypes accessors and wrapper classification/atomic allocation overhead are not individual SQL blocking spans. Wrapper overhead stays inside whole instrumented benchmark.
draft_review: Only one overlay mapping, to the existing ZBoard benchmark file. No GOMODCACHE mapping.
Original fixture invocation, before/after session counters, ReportMetrics and single production Prepare retained.
Five metadata SQL shapes plus ALTER/CREATE_TABLE/CREATE_INDEX/other categories.
Conn+Stmt direct/context query and exec, ErrSkip separated; prepare/statement close included.
Rows column metadata and optional interface shape pinned/forwarded; lifetime archived once on Close.
Transactions/session reset forwarded and counted as other; Ping/Validator/NamedValueChecker remain delegated.
Draft gofmt parses, but not compiled, run, type-checked or behavior-tested.

execution_outcome.same_session_within_each_sample: Original benchmark before/after connection-ID assertions passed.
execution_outcome.query_reconciliation: 2067 actual instrumented queries +1 original benchmark trailing connection-ID query =2068 Com_select; no extra timed SQL added.
execution_outcome.all_rows_lifetimes_once: Each successful query returned one Rows object; sum archived lifetime calls equals2067 in each sample, openRows=0.
execution_outcome.original_pool_idle: Original fixture pool is not called after probeDatabase except cleanup; no services/workers are constructed by this fixture. This was structurally preserved, not an extra SQL probe.

findings.category_scope: SQL shape classification, not Go-method stack attribution. Name bucket includes the one intentional direct database-name query.
findings.interpretation: Measured DDL driver spans dominate these instrumented samples (~70.7–73.9% whole); database-name+SCHEMATA spans are~8.2–9.4%. This is not a candidate speedup, Scan timing, unchanged-source timing or CI timeout causal finding.

instrumentation_limitations: Whole ns/op includes custom driver wrapper, category classification, closure/Rows wrapping, atomics and allocations; no paired uninstrumented cost measurement was run here.

Query/exec time excludes database/sql pool acquisition, argument conversion and GORM build/parse/logger work. Session-reset liveness and transactions are separately in other; Ping/Validator and column accessors are forwarded without individual timing.
Rows lifetime includes caller gaps/conversion between driver calls and overlaps query/consume; it is not added into disjoint totals and is not original GORM Scan-body timing.
ErrSkip attempts are separate, never treated as an executed SQL; actual fallback statement execution/prepare/close are measured.
Counters report driver calls and SQL shape, not packet capture, statement table-name attribution or migration version.
Same-DSN wrapped-pool VERSION/ping initialization is extra setup outside timer. The existing fixture/account/schema/DSN flags and one production Prepare are unchanged.
Old external-module overlay remains blocked and was not retried or bypassed. No dependency source/cache/GO environment changes.

unexecuted: No candidate metadata SQL/DDL optimization or A/B measurement.
No full suite/race/capacity/CI gate run in this task.
failed_or_unexecuted.separate_prior_failure: gorm-metadata-probe-31 receipt retains the Go GOMODCACHE-overlay rejection; it is not replaced by this successful different metric.

public_receipt_note: The pre-execution draft command is historical; command and execution_outcome record the completed three-sample diagnostic. Original private receipt remains immutable and hash-bound.
